services.name: Tandem skydive
services.desc: Tandem skydiving at Oklahoma Skydiving Center costs $240 for our most popular 14,000-foot jump. Prices range from $240 to $420 depending on altitude. Our 14,000-foot skydive offers almost twice the freefall time compared to other dropzones in the OKC and Tulsa area. Located conveniently between Oklahoma City and Tulsa, we provide an unmatched tandem skydiving experience with highly experienced, certified instructors who are passionate about welcoming first-time jumpers. We understand your first skydive is a once-in-a-lifetime experience, which is why we’re committed to providing the best possible jump at the most competitive rates in Oklahoma. Group rates can be applied to any skydives.

services.name: Learn To Skydive
services.desc: Oklahoma Skydiving Center is the only dropzone in this area that has a Turbine 206 that goes to 14,000 feet! We are a FULL-SERVICE Skydiving Center dedicated to Students AND Experienced Skydivers! We welcome experienced skydivers of all skill levels and disciplines. Whether you freefly, belly jump, wingsuit, or BASE jump, OSC is the skydiving center for you. Oklahoma Skydiving Center offers all the amenities an experienced skydiver expects for a fun day in the sky including a rigging loft for equipment maintenance if you need it.
